name: Attack
description: You attack with your main-hand weapon. Your dodge change is reduced accordingly.

name: Grapple
description: You attempt to wrestle an enemy, rendering them incapable of taking actions or reactions.

name: Help
description: You move up to 6 feet and attempt to rouse an unconscious person, or assist an ally with an assailant or condition. By passing a difficulty 10 {{skills.medicine}} check, the one you help gains 1d6 hp.

name: Block
description: You use your shield to block incoming attacks, increasing your BC until the start of your next turn.

name: Parry
description: You attempt to use your melee weapon to deflect an incoming melee attack.

name: Opportunity Attack
description: You attack an enemy that is moving out of engagement range.

name: Rest
description: You take a moment to gather you wits and redouble your resolve. Gain 1 willpower.

name: Dodge
description: You move with deliberate caution, to evade incoming attacks. You no longer provoke opportunity attacks, and your DC is increased by 2.

name: Move
description: You can move a number of feet equal to thrice your speed attribute score.

name: Jog
description: You can move a number of feet equal to six times your speed attribute score.

name: Leap
description: You leap across the battlefield, clearing a height of one third your speed score and a distance one half your speed score, in feet. If this action is taken after a move action, the horizontal distance is doubled.
